summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial is testing a drug called inclisiran sodium to see if it helps prevent major heart and blood vessel problems in people at high risk who have not had a prior major event. The study compares the drug against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. This trial is sponsored by Novartis Pharmaceuticals and has an enrollment of 14012 participants. The current status of the study is Active, not recruiting.
